title: PA-Threat: analysis code for 'Improving existing protected areas could double their threat reduction impact'
description: R and Python code, matching and estimation pipeline, and derived estimate tables for a global quasi-experimental evaluation of terrestrial protected areas designated 2001–2020 against 14 mapped anthropogenic threats. The pipeline matches 1-km grid cells inside protected areas to unprotected cells within country–biome strata, estimates average treatment effects with country and biome fixed effects, characterises heterogeneity by country, biome, biodiversity hotspot and protected-area type, fits protected-area-level regressions and a stochastic frontier model of performance gaps, and estimates species-range effects for threatened terrestrial vertebrates. Raw inputs are not redistributed (see data/README.md in the repository); derived estimate tables and per-figure source data are included.
